name: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China (中微半导体设备(上海)股份有限公司)
exchange: Shanghai Stock Exchange (STAR Market / 科创板)
blurb: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China (AMEC) is one of China's leading domestic semiconductor equipment companies, specializing in plasma etch systems and metal-organic chemical vapor deposition (MOCVD) reactors used in integrated circuit and compound semiconductor manufacturing. Founded in 2004 by Gerald Yin, a former Applied Materials executive, AMEC was among the first Chinese firms to supply etching tools to leading-edge fabs. The company competes globally with Applied Materials, Lam Research, and Tokyo Electron, and has become strategically critical to China's push for semiconductor self-sufficiency under ongoing U.S. export control regimes.
